title: Doctor report
desc: One PDF per appointment: visit questions, therapy and doses, events, imaging with lesion changes, key labs, wellbeing and alerts for the period.
audienceNewHint: Brief medical background, all milestones, imaging, labs, diary, document summaries
audienceOwnHint: Selected period only: therapy, milestones, imaging, labs, diary, alerts
questions: Visit questions on the first page
questionsHint: The list from Appointments (if prepared): what to tell the doctor, what to ask, what to show.

anamnesis.label: Medical background
anamnesis.hint: who the patient is and what happened before this period

therapy.label: Therapy
therapy.hint: medication, dose, doses taken in the period

labs.label: Labs
labs.hint: latest values, reference range, previous value

alerts.label: Alerts
alerts.hint: what was triggered in the period

documents.label: Document summaries
documents.hint: abstracts of discharge summaries and reports, made with “Summary (AI)”

noPatient: The report header won't show the patient's name and diagnosis. Add them in <link>Settings → Patient and medical background</link>.
footnote: The report is built from your records and does not replace discharge summaries. Lab values are in the units chosen in Settings; reference ranges are the ones in effect (catalog, custom or from the lab report).

dossier.title: File for AI
dossier.desc: The same data for the selected period as one text file (Markdown) for the Claude app, ChatGPT or another AI: medical background, therapy and doses, all lab values with reference ranges, studies, diary, alerts, appointments. The file starts with instructions for the model. Upload it to a chat as a file, or paste the text, and ask your questions.
dossier.notesHint: Pinned notes and the latest 12, up to 2,500 characters each.
dossier.docs: Document text from the treatment history
dossier.docsHint: Discharge summaries, histology and doctor's reports with extracted text; up to 8,000 characters per file.
dossier.allLabsHint: Otherwise only the selected period. The file gets larger.
dossier.aiHint: Visit questions and the latest lab assessment, labeled “AI answer, not fact”.
dossier.downloaded: The {size} KB file is downloading. Next: open the Claude or ChatGPT app, attach the file to a message and ask your question.
dossier.copied: Copied {n}K characters. Paste them into an AI chat as the first message.
